svg.text: Assembly and servicing: order matters
CW3-D04 · CW3-R0 · 20 October 2026 · dimensions in mm · DESIGN REVIEW
Prepare wheelset
Press wheels and stage trapped brake pieces under the approved wheelset-shop procedure.
Inner cover and flinger
Slide cover/cup from axle end; install flinger at Y580–592 using its approved shaft fit.
Housing and inner abutment
Place housing and inner outer-ring abutment before installing the bearing.
Bearing onto journal
Use approved tooling on the inner ring; seat at Y600. Check residual internal clearance.
Spacer → washer → nut
Pilot bore faces bearing. Engage washer tab; tighten by approved procedure and fold one tab.
Outer abutment and blind cap
Keep locating / floating ends distinct. Seal joints, complete grease inlet and check rotation.
Service: support and unload the bogie; remove cap, nut, washer and spacer; release inner-cover fasteners.
Withdraw housing with outer abutment removed; keep inner abutment behind bearing. Use an inner-ring extraction tool.
After bearing removal, flinger and cover can pass the smaller axle end. Wheel removal is not needed solely for these seal parts.
Tool access, extraction force, flinger removal and grease fitting are review holds. Exploded CAD is not a collision-free motion sequence.
PROPOSED DETAILS — materials, fits, fatigue, sealing performance and purchased-part interfaces require release.
Not for machining. Bearing internals / thread helix are schematic. All positive-side Y stations mirror at the left end.
